title: Physics #7 · hot meets cold: equal, apart or swap? (predict-first, lab, synthwave)

captions.instagram:
Lift the wall: hot gas meets cold. Their temperatures end up… A equal · B apart · C swap
Comment your guess before you watch 👇

Class 11 Physics · Thermodynamics + Kinetic Theory
Physics, visualised #7

600 K on one side, 200 K on the other, same pressure (so the cold side holds 3× the molecules).
Hot just means fast molecules. Every bump passes some speed from a fast one to a slow one, until both sides read 300 K → A.
It never flows back on its own: that's the second law. 2,400 molecules, real collisions, energy conserved in every one.
